title: Te Reo o te Whakahē
intro: I mua noa atu i te haerenga o te tangata tuatahi ki te whenua, i tū mai tētahi mea tino mana nui i roto i tētahi ao rangimārie, e karapotia ana e ngā wairua tino pono. I te tukunga o tētahi whakahau kotahi, ka piko katoa ngā reo ki te ngohengohe—engari kotahi te reo i ara ake hei whakahē, ā, ka rangona taua whakahē puta noa i ngā tau katoa tae noa ki te Rā Whakamutunga. Ko wai tēnei mea kua hinga?
clues: I hangaia ahau i tētahi mea e kā ana, ā, ko ētahi atu i tōku taha i hangaia i tētahi mea i hikoi ai rātou.
I noho ahau i te wāhi tapu i waenganui i ngā tāngata tapu, ā, nō te whakahau kotahi i huripokitia ai ngā mea katoa.
I te taenga mai o te whakahau, ka piko katoa ngā wairua, engari ko ahau anake; i whānau mai taku whakakahore i te whakapehapeha.
I peia ahau i taua wāhi tapu, i tohua ki te kanga e mau tonu ana ake ake.
I inoi ahau kia wātea te wā tae noa ki te Rā o te Aranga, ā, i whakaaetia. I oati ahau ki te whakatata atu ki ngā wairua katoa, ki te ārahi i a rātou ki te hē.
A te tangi o te tetere, ko te hunga i aru i ahau ka rite ki ahau i roto i te ahi e mura ana, a kahore he kaiawhina hei whakaora i a ratou.

trial.label: Te Wā Whakahirahira
options: Te kore e piko ki mua i a Ātama
Te tango i te atuatanga ki runga i tētahi emepaea nui
Te whakatakoto mahere kia maka te tangata tika ki roto i te mura
Te ārahi i tētahi iwi ki te karakia ki tētahi whakapakoko koura
Te toremi i tētahi ope nui ki te moana
trial.answer: Te kore e piko ki mua i a Ātama

location.label: Te Wāhi Tapu
options: Jannah (Pararaiha)
He whare rangatira ataahua i te awa o te Naera
He pourewa pereki e toro atu ana ki te rangi
He kuao kau koura i hangaia mai i ngā whakapaipai
He oumu ahi e mura ana

outcome.label: Te Whakamutunga o te Ao
options: Peia atu, me te okiokinga tae noa ki te Rā i whakaaria mai
I toremi ki ngā ope taua i raro i ngā ngaru
I pakaruhia e ngā kōhatu i whiua mai i te rangi
I haehaea e ngā kahui manu e rere ana
I pau i te pahūtanga kotahi
outcome.answer: Peia atu, me te okiokinga tae noa ki te Rā i whakaaria mai

arabic: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
verse: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me [i.e., my death] until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few." (17:62)
